text.card: Exchange four marked toy tokens using forward steps and opposing-color hops.
text.hands_empty: Put down what you hold before indexing a token.
text.layout_changed: The layout has changed. Read the current pads and choose an offered move for that layout.
text.already_initial: The board is already at its initial layout. Try an available forward move.
text.rules: An introductory five-pad diagram with four original toy frog tokens and one vacancy. Seen from the front contact side, pads 1 through 5 run left to right. Green tokens move only right; brown tokens move only left, as the fixed colored arrows show. A token may step into the adjacent vacancy or hop exactly one opposing-color token into the vacancy two pads away. No backward move or same-color hop is allowed. The initial layout is GG_BB; the fixed T BB_GG heading states the exchanged-color goal.
text.identities: The same four whole marked toy assemblies stay present. Within each color, the left token is numbered 1 and the right token 2, initially G1/G2 on pads1/2 and B1/B2 on pads4/5. Their relative order never changes, so each number stays with its original colored token in all23 layouts. A single whole-layout Set indexes the diagram. No loose custody, output, live animal or Soul jumping, precise individual-token finger contact, physical hop trajectory or collision-free simultaneous interpolation is claimed.
text.layouts: Stable layout index mapping: 0=GG_BB, 1=G_GBB, 2=GGB_B, 3=_GGBB, 4=GBG_B, 5=G_BGB, 6=GGBB_, 7=GB_GB, 8=GBGB_, 9=_GBGB, 10=_BGGB, 11=GBBG_, 12=GB_BG, 13=BG_GB, 14=B_GGB, 15=GBB_G, 16=_BGBG, 17=BGBG_, 18=B_GBG, 19=BGB_G, 20=BBG_G, 21=B_BGG, 22=BB_GG. G is green, B is brown, and _ is the vacancy. There are23 reachable layouts,26 forward moves, four expected non-goal dead ends and one goal. Reset is available at every noninitial layout and returns the same four originals to GG_BB. It is refused when already initial.
text.worked: A shortest solution has eight moves. The worked source-specific sequence follows the offered how-to; each step or hop changes only the selected source and vacancy positions. Dead ends are normal puzzle work: use reset, then try another route. This small fixed puzzle has no automatic solver, hint engine, score, winner counter, arbitrary swap, timer, hidden state or animal behavior.
